plain: Chris Ramsay, a YouTuber who talks about UFOs, tells Jesse Michels to listen to Diana Pasulka, a religion scholar who studies belief in UFOs. He says she talks a lot about the ritual-like routines that rocket teams in the United States perform before a launch. He brings it up to suggest that even hard science carries a hidden religious side.
